body.name: Knead Blood Bag
body.description: A blood bag extracted from the body of a Hell Maggot. Clumps of decay and sticky blood are mixed inside, slowly solidifying.

body.name: Kobold's Ear
body.description: Leathery in texture and encased in frost, these ears bear traces of what appears to be black earwax.

body.name: Krampus' Coin
body.description: A coin engraved with Krampus’s face. It is a small token of his favor, given only to those who have done good.

body.name: Krampus’ Golden Bell
body.description: This small golden bell, known for its clear and gentle chime, can only be obtained by those who have truly pleased Krampus. It is said that those who ring it are granted a special blessing from him.

body.name: Krampus’ Silver Bell
body.description: This small silver bell, known for its clear and gentle chime, can only be found during the winter when Krampus appears. It is said that those who ring it are granted a small blessing from him.
